AN ACT TO AMEND THE APPROPRIATION ACT, NO. 30 OF 2017
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic SocialistRepublic of Sri Lanka as follows:-
1. This Act may be cited as the Appropriation(Amendment) Act, No. of 2018.
2.The First Schedule to the Appropriation Act, No. 30of 2017 (hereinafter referred to as the “principle enactment”)is hereby repealed and the following is substitutedtherefor:—
